authors: Jens Niedermeyer; Fabian Schlenker; Berend Denkena; Roland Lachmayer
name: luh-process-parameter-investigation-of-scalmalloyr-minimizing-the-relative-density
notes: In this dataset, a design of experiments is performed to analyze the relationships between different process parameters in the PBF-LB/M process with the resulted relative density. In order to investigate the density, specimens in the shape of cubes by the dimensions 10x10x10 mm³ are manufactured according the parameters defined in the DoE for laser power, scanning speed and hatching distance. Afterwards, the specimens are separated from the build platform and embedded and polished. The specimens are analyzed by using light microscope images and calculating the relative density by dividing the surface to their pores.
